verdict.rationale: Lambda's own docs show self-serve deployment of current-generation NVIDIA B200, H100 and GH200 instances, with B200/H100 also offered as 1-Click Clusters. The pricing page also lists the previous-generation A100 alongside them, so engineers can pick between current and older GPUs. missing for 10: no evidence of H200 availability, no documented A100 pricing showing it is the cheaper option, no independent or hands-on confirmation of the A100 tier.
